messages:
tasha-sec: Alert from Onyx private deploy: keystore-agent pods started failing after we applied stricter netpols. Audit events dropped. Locking down here to coordinate.

audit-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0421, severity=high. Paging infra oncall.

leo-infra: which netpol got applied and when?

priya-sre: We rolled the tightened egress policy at 03:12 UTC to enforce tenancy outbound-only to our approved HSM endpoints. It limited outbound to 10.11.0.0/24 and specific ports.

oliver-ops: keystore-agent logs from one pod (trimmed):
```
2026-04-21T03:16:05Z INFO starting keystore-agent v2.0.0-alpha
2026-04-21T03:17:14Z WARN TLS handshake timeout to 10.11.5.20
2026-04-21T03:17:14Z ERROR decrypt failed: missing response from KMS
2026-04-21T03:17:14Z PANIC runtime error: index out of range
```

tasha-sec: index out of range => code bug or unexpected empty set from HSM. But correlation with netpol timing suggests packets blocked or routed to wrong IP. Any HSM rotation/maintenance this morning?

vendor-hsm-bot: Scheduled maintenance: certificate rollover started at 03:10 UTC; new endpoint assigned 10.11.5.20 -> 10.11.6.45 (short window). See incident: https://vendor.example.com/inc/4521

leo-infra: aha. so netpol permissions only allowed 10.11.5.0/24. New IP 10.11.6.45 is outside. That explains the handshake timeouts.

priya-sre: mitigation proposal: 1) temporarily expand egress to 10.11.6.45/32; 2) scale keystore-agent replicas to 3; 3) rollback to v1.9.4 (non-alpha) if crashes persist; 4) create ephemeral RBAC 'keystore-incident-access' for 1h for sec+oncall.

leo-infra: kubectl snippet to patch netpol (I will apply):
```bash
kubectl -n onyx-keystore apply -f - <<'YAML'
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-hsm-egress-temp
  namespace: onyx-keystore
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: keystore-agent
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.11.6.45/32
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
YAML
```

oliver-ops: Also proposing we add an init probe that checks KMS TLS and logs the SNI/cert chain before agent starts. Helps for future HSM cert rotates.

tasha-sec: Approve ephemeral RBAC for 1h. @audit-bot ensure that the RBAC grant/event is logged to the audit bucket and immutable.

audit-bot: Creating AU-2026-223 snapshot and WORM copy to s3://redwood-private-audit/Onyx/2026-04-21/. Access: sec+audit only.

vendor-hsm-bot: Note from vendor: when certificate rollover occurs, some clients that pin SANs without SAN fallback may receive empty responses; recommended client change: treat empty decrypt responses as transient 503 and retry with exponential backoff. See KB: https://vendor.example.com/kb/empty-decrypts

priya-sre: Long-term tasks: 1) vendor advisory changes to client (don't panic on empty payloads), 2) add explicit allowlist ranges for vendor maintenance windows, 3) add egress-policy-rotation playbook for oncall.

leo-infra: For immediate: applying netpol change now (03:24 UTC). Rolling agent to v1.9.4 as a fallback if panic continues.

oliver-ops: 03:29 UTC  netpol applied. 03:31 UTC rolling keystore-agent to v1.9.4.

oliver-ops: 03:37 UTC pods stable, no panic loops. Audit forwarding resumed at 03:38:12.

priya-sre: Monitoring metrics: decrypt error spike cleared, latency back to baseline. We'll watch for 60m.

tasha-sec: Post-incident controls:
- Update isolation guarantees doc to include 'vendor endpoint rotation' exception and required IP allowlist practices.
- Add automated netpol integration test that simulates vendor IP changes and validates agent fallbacks.
- Require keystore-agent to fail gracefully (503) on empty decrypt blob instead of panic.

leo-infra: I'll open RFC RFC-2026-KS-FALLBACK and a PR to change panic->error path. Also add readiness probe change to fail ready but keep container running so we can exec.

oliver-ops: Filing mitigation ticket MIT-2026-44 to track the temporary netpol change and the RBAC emergency grant expiry.

priya-sre: Also propose a policy for maintenance windows: vendor must pre-announce IP changes 1h in advance to our control plane, or we'll auto-allow in a predefined emergency managed CIDR for 30m.

tasha-sec: Sounds good. Please capture decisions in PM notes. We'll treat this as a near-miss for compliance (no exfil, no key compromise). Postmortem assigned PM-2026-89 to @tasha-sec + @leo-infra + @priya-sre.

audit-bot: Postmortem ticket created PM-2026-89. Evidence archived.

oliver-ops: Quick reminder: avoid future sweeping netpol tightenings during vendor maintenance windows; coordinate with sec and infra.

tasha-sec: Agreed. Closing incident when 60m stable. Thanks all. :lock_with_ink_pen:
